command.title: PREMIER Command
command.description: The write command to execute (e.g. FA_OUT_ADD).

column_mapping.title: Column Mapping
column_mapping.description: Map input table columns to PREMIER parameter names.

dedup_key_column.title: Deduplication Key Column
dedup_key_column.description: Optional input column used as a natural key so re-runs skip already-written rows. Leave empty to re-send every row (may create duplicates).

continue_on_error.title: Continue On Error
continue_on_error.description: If enabled, failed rows are recorded and the job continues; otherwise it aborts on the first failure.
